title: Endurance charge
wikitext:
{{status
| name                   = Endurance Charge
| type                   = Charge
|description = Players gain additional Physical and Elemental Damage Reduction for each Endurance Charge they have
| bonuses                = {{#cargo_query: tables=generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%endurance_charge%" AND id NOT LIKE "%max%"
|format = ul
}}
}}

'''Endurance charges''' are one of the three [[charge]] types. They are associated with [[strength]], and grant additional physical and elemental [[damage reduction]]. They are visualized as glowing red orbs surrounding the character.

__TOC__

==Effects on monsters==
The effects of endurance charges are much more significant on  (non-minion) [[monster]]s.
* 15% additional Physical [[Damage reduction|Damage Reduction]] per [[Endurance Charge]] 
* +15% to all [[Elemental Resistance|Elemental Resistances]] per [[Endurance Charge]]

==Theoretical maximum number of endurance charges obtained==
A quick summary of how the maximum number of +x to maximum endurance charges can be obtained from various sources.
This will ignore sources that make endurance charges unobtainable such as [[Arn's Anguish]] and effects that change the limit to track other stats such as [[Masterful Form]]
The table includes legacy content so this theoretical maxium of 26 is only obtainable in permanent leagues.
{| class="wikitable"
|+ Caption text
|-
! Source !! Quantity !! How !! Challenge league available
|-
| Base || 3 || || Yes
|-
| Passive skills || 3 || [[Endurance]],[[Stamina]],[[Vigour]] || Yes
|-
| Ascendancy passive || 1 || [[Unflinching]], [[Conviction of Power]] or [[Unleashed Potential]] || Yes
|-
| Tattoo || 1 || [[Honoured Tattoo of the Mountain]] || No
|-
| Rings || 3x2 || Using [[Reflecting Mist]] on a Sentinels [[Manifold Ring]] || No
|-
| Amulet || 2 || Perfect roll [[Eyes of the Greatwolf]] that has [[Taurus Talisman]] enchantment || Yes
|-
| Belt || 1 || Legacy corruption on synthesised implicit || Yes
|-
| Body Armour || 1 || Foulborn [[Ambu's Charge]] || Yes
|-
| Boots || 2 || Corrupted [[Death's Door]] || Yes
|-
| Main Hand || 4 || Shaper's Eventuality Rod with Cruicible tree || No
|-
| Off Hand || 1 || Synthesised shield || No
|-
|| Jewels || 2 || [[Sublime Vision]] and [[Bound By Destiny]] || Yes

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Endurance Charges on Players and Minions no longer grant 4% to all Elemental Resistances per Endurance Charge. They now instead grant 4% additional Elemental Damage Reduction per Endurance Charge.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0|
* Minions now gain the same bonuses from Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charges as players do, rather than the significantly elevated bonuses that other Monsters gain.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* The reward from the {{ql|The Bandit Lord Alira}}/{{ql|The Bandit Lord Kraityn}}/{{ql|The Bandit Lord Oak}} have changed.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.0|
* The bandit leaders now grant different stat bonuses on each difficulty level. For Oak in Merciless difficulty: maximum '''endurance charges'''.
* Monsters now gain 15% physical and elemental resistance per '''Endurance Charge''', rather than 20%.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.6|
* Reduced [[physical damage reduction]] from 5% to 4% per Endurance Charge.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.5|
* Improved Endurance Charges from 4% to 5% [[damage reduction]].
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.2|
* You can only gain one charge of each type per action now. (Only applied to frenzy charges, [[power charge]]s, and [[endurance charge]]s)
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.1|
* You can now only gain one charge of each type per action you perform, all stats gained per active charge are now slightly worse. (Only applied to [[frenzy charge]]s, [[power charge]]s, and endurance charges).
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.0|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
